options.label: A
options.action: Do not administer additional HepB vaccination (routine additional doses not recommended).

options.label: B
options.action: Administer HepB vaccination; if vaccinating in pregnancy, use Engerix-B, Recombivax HB, or Twinrix (avoid Heplisav-B and PreHevbrio in pregnancy per insufficient safety data).

options.label: C
options.action: Consider prevaccination testing (HBsAg, anti-HBs, and anti-HBc) which may be performed concomitantly with administration of the first vaccine dose; vaccination should proceed for those recommended.

options.label: D
options.action: Administer HepB vaccination (universal recommendation for adults aged 19–59 years; lack of access to serologic testing should not be a barrier; testing is not required).

options.label: E
options.action: Administer HepB vaccination (recommended for adults aged ≥60 years with risk factors; lack of access to serologic testing should not be a barrier; testing is not required).

options.label: F
options.action: HepB vaccination may be given; if vaccinating in pregnancy, use Engerix-B, Recombivax HB, or Twinrix (avoid Heplisav-B and PreHevbrio in pregnancy per insufficient safety data).

options.label: G
options.action: HepB vaccination may be given (offer vaccination to adults aged ≥60 years without known risk factors).

options.label: H
options.action: Unable to determine vaccination recommendation from this guideline pathway because age does not fall within adult cohorts addressed (19–59 or ≥60); refer to other age-based guidance.

options.label: I
options.action: Unable to determine adult vaccination recommendation from this guideline pathway because patient is not age 19–59 or ≥60; refer to other age-based guidance.

options.label: J
options.action: Insufficient explicit patient evidence to select a guideline recommendation.
